articles.title: New York sues Kalshi, alleges it offers a gambling platform 'plain and simple'
articles.snippet: The suit wants to bar the company from operating what it says is an unlicensed gambling business and seeks financial redress.

articles.title: AMLBot launches AI Tracer for self-service blockchain investigations
articles.snippet: Crypto forensics company AMLBot launched an AI-enabled tool allowing users with no specialist knowledge to trace their digital assets, even after they are stolen.

articles.title: Crypto’s next altseason may have fewer winners: Wintermute
articles.snippet: Institutional investors accounted for 72% of Wintermute’s spot OTC flow in the first half of 2026 as capital clustered in fewer tokens and altcoin rallies became more selective.

articles.title: US senators sent revised ethics rules to White House for CLARITY Act: Report
articles.snippet: The window to pass a comprehensive crypto market structure bill before the Senate breaks for a month-long recess is closing, with ethics a dividing issue for many lawmakers.

articles.title: Telegram’s Pavel Durov responds to Russia’s terrorism designation
articles.snippet: The Telegram founder said Russia designated him a terrorist after he refused government demands for mass surveillance and censorship on the messaging platform.
